key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the kunya (nominal epithet) of the narrator
key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak, a technical term indicating a narrator whose reliability is not sufficient for independent legal deduction

ai.seo_question: What is the status of the narrator Hamdan in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry identifies the narrator Hamdan ibn Abi al--Hakam (Abū Jaʿfar) and classifies him as 'weak' (daʿīf) in the science of hadith criticism (ʿilm al-ajāz wa al-taʿdīl).
